info.title: Class Action Cash
info.description: Qull Connect API. Supply a per-user API key in Authorization: Bearer <key>. Keys identify one customer; arbitrary platform/user-id headers are not accepted. Payment setup opens hosted Stripe Checkout and does not charge a service fee. Use the record's billing/status operation to verify setup, then explicitly authorize the applicable fee. See the linked guide for workflow and service limits.

settlements.eligibility_summary: Potential class members: US and territory residents who paid for qualifying insured prescriptions at Kroger-owned pharmacies between December 9, 2018 and August 23, 2026. Receipt keywords alone do not establish eligibility. Claim identification and proof requirements depend on administrator records and claimed spending; read the official notice before filing.
settlements.name: Kroger $17M Prescription Drug Pricing Settlement
settlements.typical_payout_range: Variable pro rata payment based on qualifying prescription spending, valid claims and court approval. No individual payout or timing is guaranteed.

settlements.eligibility_summary: US purchasers of VSL#3 for personal use between June 1, 2016 and June 19, 2019. The official notice describes household limits, proof/notice-credential rules and exclusions. Receipt keywords alone do not establish eligibility.
settlements.name: VSL#3 Probiotic $20M False Advertising Settlement
settlements.typical_payout_range: $20 per qualifying unit before possible adjustments. No-proof household claims are generally limited to one unit; proof or notice credentials may support more units under the official notice, up to 40. Payments may increase or decrease based on available funds.

data_freshness.warning: Deadlines and eligibility must be confirmed with each official administrator before filing. Unverified, expired and stale entries are excluded.

value.user_message: 2 source-verified, unexpired settlement opportunities are available. Receipt matches identify candidates; they do not establish eligibility.
